problems.title: Graceful Labeling - Caterpillar Trees n≤12
problems.result: All 560 non-isomorphic caterpillar trees with n≤12 vertices admit graceful labelings (computational verification, 0 failures)
problems.note: Bounded computational verification (status: heuristic), NOT claim-ready and NOT a proof (no Lean build). Caterpillars already known graceful for ALL n (Rosa 1967/Golomb), so this run is a sanity check with witnesses over 560 distinct classes, not new mathematics. Earlier '2,142 trees / verified' was a representation count (enumeration only removed reflections, not spine-shift duplicates); corrected to 560 distinct after adversarial review (OPE-18). Does not prove the general Graceful Tree Conjecture.
residual_risks: search is heuristic (backtracking); absence of failure not a proof
no Lean build of witnesses or enumeration
novelty: family already known graceful for all n
count relies on enumeration + AHU cross-check agreeing
